text:
aj: Anyone else seeing intermittent 401s when streaming from CI (GitHub Actions) but not locally? Started after we moved the runner to an alpine image.
maria: only in CI? what SDK/lang?
aj: Go SDK. Local runs fine. CI shows 401s about 30% of requests, only for streaming endpoints. Non-streaming calls ok.
kai: do you mount the API key from a file or put it into env? also which base image? musl/alpine sometimes behaves odd with shell utils.
aj: GH actions inject via env from secrets. Dockerfile uses `ARG API_KEY` then `ENV API_KEY="${API_KEY}"` at build time (we pass build-arg). image is `alpine:3.18` with `bash` installed.
maria: build-time vs run-time secrets can bite. Also curious if there's any trailing char in the key. can you dump hex of the char stream inside the container?
aj: did `docker run` with a quick debug script: ```sh
> printf "%s" "${API_KEY}" | base64
> printf "%s" "${API_KEY}" | od -An -t x1
``` got output `dGVzdGtleQ0K` for base64 and `0d 0a` at the end in od. so there was a CRLF appended.
oliver: aha so the Authorization header becomes `Basic dGVzdGtleQ0K` — server decodes and sees trailing CRLF bytes -> mismatch -> 401 sometimes? Explain why intermittently: maybe some proxies/SDK strip, some don't.
kai: in streaming path we keep raw bytes longer (KV cache / header reuse), so extra invisible bytes might break handshake. Non-streaming path maybe has extra sanitization.
maria: how did CRLF get there? GH secrets shouldn't. Windows newlines on the machine that created the secret? or echo adding newline when building image.
aj: repro: I had a local file `apikey.txt` with CRLF (created on Windows). At build I did `--build-arg API_KEY="$(cat apikey.txt)"` which preserved CR/LF.
devex-bot: Tip: prefer `printf %s` over `echo` to avoid automatic newlines. Also use `base64 -w0` on Linux to avoid wrapping. :information_source:
oliver: quick fixes: 1) strip newlines at build: `API_KEY=$(tr -d '\r\n' < apikey.txt)` 2) in Dockerfile set `ENV API_KEY="$(printf %s "${API_KEY}")"` 3) or pass as runtime env secret rather than build-arg.
kai: for debugging inside container: `cat -v <<<"${API_KEY}"` shows `^M` if CR present. or `od -c` shows `\r`/`\n`.
maria: for Go specifically, ensure you call `strings.TrimSpace(apiKey)` or trim `\r` if you have to, but better to fix at source.
aj: thanks — I switched GH action to `echo -n "${{ secrets.API_KEY }}" >> /tmp/apikey` and updated build args. retested on runner: streams stable, no 401s. also added an assertion in our CI smoke test: `[[ $(printf "%s" "${API_KEY}" | od -An -t x1 | tr -d ' \n') =~ [0-9a-f] ]]` silly but catches CR.
oliver: nice. maybe add a short doc blurb in devex quick tips about build-arg vs run-time secrets and the CRLF gotcha on Windows.
maria: +1. can someone file a tiny PR to docs/examples? :thumbsup:
aj: I'll open a PR and link this thread. thanks all :raised_hands:
